_note: What we can make well from the material a teacher sends. Shared by the order page (live warnings) and the onboarding agent (agents/onboarding.md). Pilot estimates, owner Nov 5, 2026; recalibrate from real orders (docs/FEASIBILITY.md).

questionsPerPage._why: distinct, fair questions one page of source supports without repeating itself; A/B versions don't count twice

mcInTesting.note: only when the teacher picks the menu option "Add multiple choice on passages (in testing)": at least 8 mc a version so the no-passage line (chance + 15 points) is fair, 4 choices, no Part A/Part B pairs, plus 2 citing short answers and the RACE; the onboarding agent warns that it is in testing (owner, Nov 7, 2026)

readingquiz.note: owner, Nov 7, 2026 (after four ELA tries failed the fresh no-passage probe): sold as short answers that quote the passage plus a RACE response, no multiple choice, until a passage-based multiple-choice version passes two fresh final probes per version (docs/ROADMAP.md). A passage of about 250–350 words supports about 3–4 citing short answers; each short answer asks for a claim plus a quote or paragraph-specific detail, and earns at most half its credit without the passage. No multiple-choice Part A/Part B pairs (owner, Nov 7, 2026)

versions.note: same number and types as the teacher's test

project.turnIn: a product plus a short reflection

fromStandardsOnly._why: when the source is only standards, the maker writes the lessons itself, so we can make more, but the fact checker and blind tester carry more weight

messages.tooMany: {asked} questions from about {pages} page(s) of material is more than it can support without repeating itself. From what you sent, we can make about {low}–{high} good questions. Add more source material, lower the number, or let us use our best judgment.
messages.noSource: We need something to work from: notes, a chapter, standards or an old test.
messages.defaultUsed: If you leave this blank, we'll use the most common mix for your grade and subject: {default}.

mathPracticePerPage._why: owner call delegated Nov 5, 2026: in math the same skill with new numbers is a fair new practice question, so practice items can draw more from a page; tests and quizzes keep questionsPerPage

format._note: Owner, Nov 8, 2026 (docs/KINDS-INTERACTIVE-FORMAT.md): menu items with interactive: true can be made printable or as an interactive page. Same tokens and the same question counts either way: the format changes how students answer, not how much the source supports.
